en.headline: 29 own commits plus 30 automated commits across three repositories
en.summary: **29 own commits** were recorded across three repositories, plus 30 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, work covered CI wording checks, code-map baselines, schedule reconciliation, constant ownership, data contracts, and site rendering refactors that extracted Markdown rendering and the homepage into separate modules. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, six commits adjusted menu selection and hover states, theme and language controls, title spacing, card sizing, and README links. In `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`, four commits added Google translation presets and a public test-key button, Chrome built-in translation, and contributor documentation. The user opened or closed 1 issue: `openchamber/openchamber` issue #5556, “[Bug] Files view: dragging across line numbers to comment is unreliable (web, desktop, VS Code extension)”. `openchamber-bot[bot]` replied to that issue with a `fix-ready` note tracing the drag state machine to gutter-bound handlers. The user also started two discussions in `openchamber/openchamber`: #5555, “[Idea] Files view: comment on the selected code, not only on selected line numbers”, and #5554, “[Idea] VS Code extension: fall back to the OpenCode 2.x that ships with the desktop app”.

zh.headline: 29 次本人提交，另有 30 次自动提交，覆盖三个仓库
zh.summary: 当天在三个仓库完成 **29 次本人提交**，另有 30 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`，工作涉及 CI 措辞检查、代码映射基线、调度对账、常量归属、数据契约，以及将 Markdown 渲染与首页拆分到独立模块的站点重构。在 `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`，6 次提交调整了菜单选中态与悬停态、主题和语言控件、标题行距、卡片尺寸及 README 链接。在 `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate`，4 次提交新增 Google 翻译预设与公开测试密钥按钮、Chrome 内置翻译及贡献者文档。用户新开或关闭了 1 个 issue：`openchamber/openchamber` 的 #5556 “[Bug] Files view: dragging across line numbers to comment is unreliable (web, desktop, VS Code extension)”。`openchamber-bot[bot]` 回复该 issue，给出 `fix-ready` 说明，并将拖拽状态机追溯到行号栏事件处理器。用户还在 `openchamber/openchamber` 发起了两个讨论：#5555 “[Idea] Files view: comment on the selected code, not only on selected line numbers” 和 #5554 “[Idea] VS Code extension: fall back to the OpenCode 2.x that ships with the desktop app”。
